items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: That's when Bouchon joined the band because Jack Webber got married to this gal, Dixie Brown.

ctx.x: That's when Bouchon joined the band because Jack Webber got married to this gal, Dixie Brown. She was singing at the Archard Cafe. That's the Rigside now.
